issues.description: Method getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement contains a contradiction: the UML diagram (problem_statement.md) declares getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning void, while the textual task description in the same problem_statement and the reference solution implement it as returning String (format: LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)). This mismatch between the UML and the textual instructions/solution can confuse students about which return type to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md so the method signature matches the textual description and the solution: change the UML line from getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): void to getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String. Also update any diagram rendering (PlantUML) and any example usages or comments in the template to consistently indicate the method returns a String in the format "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)".
